requiredFindings.failureScenario: repository-file-inventory.v111.json standing says law X3b r9, unit X3b-3. operation-handoff-x2e-inventory-v111/successor.json standing says the same. evidence/build_v111.py writes both sentences, and it writes the descriptions of operation_handoff.rs and carrier_operation.rs, which cite law X3b r9. The handoff description says that after an uncertain outcome nothing more runs, and that otherwise the end step runs; it does not say that a closed attempt ledger does not enter the end step. The unit implements r10: ProjectOperation::end returns NotEntered, with no walk and no disclosure, when the owner reports Uncertain or the attempt ledger is closed (journal-x3b r10 item 4). Required: both standing sentences and both new production descriptions name law X3b r10; the handoff description states that a closed attempt ledger does not enter the end step; the builder literals that emit those sentences match. The carrier description does not have to narrate that decision, which belongs to the handoff. Inherited rows stay by value. The two test descriptions already state the behavior they check and do not name r9.
